_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.title: Per-scope vocabulary
requirements.description: Operators should create and update each scope's facet vocabulary, retention rules, residency budgets, and frontier target.

validation.notes: Transactional facet policy mutation validates scope, retention, compaction eligibility, and residency.

requirements.title: Federated scope discovery
requirements.description: Search clients should discover one provider per scope and receive scope-labelled results without duplicate corpus answers.

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SL-P1-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.title: Corpus-first operator surface
requirements.description: The operator UI should provide a ledger list, scope detail, journal timeline, frontier explorer, vocabulary editor, and cross-scope search.

validation.notes: Source Ledger live operator pages cover the corpus list, scope detail, timeline, frontier, vocabulary editor, and cross-scope search.

requirements.title: Append-only migration seam
requirements.description: The ledger should support a verified migration that preserves entry bodies and dependent derived data without deleting source rows.

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SL-P1-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.title: Measured recall cost
requirements.description: The ledger should measure recall cost and apply a bounded candidate strategy when corpus growth exceeds the recorded latency ceiling.

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:SL-P1-005] tag) once the behavior exists.
